title: A characterization of Griffiths semipositivity by top-degree optimal $\bar \partial$-estimates
summary: We prove that a singular Hermitian metric $h$ on a vector bundle agrees almost everywhere with a Griffiths semipositive metric if its dual metric $h^*$ is locally integrable and the $\bar \partial$-equation admits solutions with optimal $L^2$-estimates for $(n,n)$-forms, where $n$ is the dimension of the base manifold. In particular, under this integrability assumption, Nakano semipositivity in the sense of optimal estimates implies Griffiths semipositivity.
